category_title: Preschoolers with Autism and communication delays who exhibit physical aggression during activity transitions
minimal_context: Chris is in his pre-kindergarten classroom being asked to transition from playtime to a table activity.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Chris, it is time to clean up the toys and go to the table for our next activity.

STUDENT: No! (Drops to the floor)

TUTOR: We have to follow the schedule. Please get up.

STUDENT: (Elopes from the activity area)

TUTOR: Chris, you need to come back and transition to the table right now.

STUDENT: (Engages in physical aggression by kicking and throwing items in the classroom)

options.A: Ask Chris if he had a tough time at home the previous night before the transition.
options.B: Review the first/then card with Chris, showing "first table activity, then a preferred item."
options.C: Provide verbal warnings to Chris about the upcoming transition to the table activity.
options.D: Help Chris reflect on the consequences of his actions and the emotions of the other children.
